parts.text: Candid documentary photograph, 16:9, shot on a Sony A7 IV with a 50mm f/1.8 lens, natural available light only. Front-facing eye-level medium shot across a desk: an American software engineer, white man, about 28, short tousled light-brown hair, light natural stubble, a few freckles, real skin with visible pores and slight unevenness, relaxed natural expression looking at his screen with a faint smirk, wearing a heather-grey crew-neck t-shirt under an open olive-green overshirt. He sits behind an open silver MacBook Pro (back of the lid toward the camera, plain aluminium). Real lived-in home office in Brooklyn: white brick wall, a wooden shelf with a few books and a small plant, a window on the left with soft overcast daylight, a coffee mug on the desk. Slight film grain, true-to-life colour, gentle highlight roll-off, shallow depth of field. It must look like an unretouched real photo of a real person — not CGI, not a 3D render, not airbrushed, no plastic skin, no symmetry perfection. No text, no logos except the plain Apple logo.
